design.base_tuning_objective_and_grids: unchanged Step 18 all-23 robust objective and grids
design.calibration: three-member split ensemble; each member tuned on base patients and sigmoid-fit on separate clean patients
design.calibration_data: one row per clean calibration patient; no coherent images used for calibration fit
design.calibrator: training-calibration-patient StandardScaler then LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=2000,random_state=42); no class or image weights
design.ensemble_prediction: mean member calibrated patient probabilities, after patient aggregation within each member
design.interpretation: posthoc development analysis; calibration quality must be measured, not assumed
design.method_selection_after_outer_results: forbidden; no isotonic/threshold/model switching after calibration results
design.model_choice_basis: posthoc Step 19 development five-condition BA; not a significance claim

patient_score.logreg: logit of mean image malignancy probability, clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]

design.threshold_status: fixed research threshold; not clinically optimized or validated

limitations: Posthoc development-based model choice; fixed threshold is research-only, not a clinical decision rule.
missing_coherent_policy: fail checkpoint if any test image lacks a valid coherent condition; do not silently drop or replace views
original_perturbations: preserved development experiment; not regenerated for primary held-out evaluation
primary_endpoint: SVM clean patient balanced accuracy at fixed probability threshold 0.5
secondary_endpoints: LR clean metrics and paired LR/SVM clean difference
clean and perturbed probability Brier/log loss
test_once_policy: evaluate both fixed ensembles once; no retraining, model switching, threshold tuning or feature changes after seeing test results
uncertainty_plan: 10000 paired patient bootstrap replicates within test diagnosis, seed 42; pointwise percentile 95%; fixed fitted models
